text:
Ivy Laurent: hi everyone 44b first day in product/design! two quick blockers: 1) can't access the 'Redwood Patterns' Figma file (403) 2) where is the single-source roadmap + research repo? also curious who owns the stipend budget for recruiting participants
Marco Rivera: welcome Ivy!! Figma email? i'll add you to the Design org and the Patterns file. what's your email?
Ivy Laurent: ivy.laurent@redwood.ai thanks Marco
onboarding-helper-bot: Hi Ivy 44b Welcome checklist: 1) Request Figma access 2) Join #design-ops and #product-sync 3) Read Product Roadmap (Notion) 4) Read Research Playbook + request Maze/Lookback seats. Link: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/onboarding-product
Marco Rivera: invite sent to your email. roadmap is Notion > Product > Roadmaps > Live (we snapshot weekly). the research repo (recordings + transcripts) lives in Notion under Product > Research > Studies and we also link recordings in a private S3 bucket (internal links on each study page).
Sasha Bloom: hey Ivy 44b welcome! for stipend budget, design-ops manages small study stipends up to $500. for larger budgets talk to me and finance will route it. recruiting and panel requests go through the design-ops form on the Research Playbook.
Ivy Laurent: got the invite, can open Patterns now 389 thanks Marco. a couple process Qs: 1) whats our crit cadence and how to submit a deck for critique? 2) who owns the Figma plugin token sync and how to request a plugin API key (i want to sync tokens to code)
Kelsey Tran: welcome Ivy! critique sessions are weekly Wednesdays 4pm PT in #design-crit — add your file link to the critique board (Notion > Design Crits) by Tue EOD to be on the agenda.
Marco Rivera: plugin keys: we use the tokens-sync plugin and keys are issued by design-ops + eng-platform. fill the small request form (Notion > Design > Plugin Keys) and tag @Kelsey Tran for the platform approval. small safety note: keys are rotated and scoped to a team.
Ivy Laurent: thanks, also curious about the tokens workflow: can designers push a tokens.json to the repo or does it go through a PR process? trying to set up a small experiment to automate spacing token updates from Figma
Kelsey Tran: tokens flow: designers create or update tokens in a feature Figma file, then export via the plugin to a draft branch in the design-system repo. any merge to main requires a PR with visual-diff checks and an eng-platform signoff. we run automated visual diffs (Percy) and a short 15m review if it affects global tokens.
Sasha Bloom: if you're running experiments ping me and we can earmark a small feature branch and test participants. also file a quick note in the research board so ops can budget stipends if needed.
Ivy Laurent: perfect. one last thing: where do we keep past roadmaps & decision logs? i'd like to review previous quarter's tradeoffs
Marco Rivera: Roadmap snapshots are in Notion under Product > Roadmaps > Snapshots (quarterly). Decision logs / RFCs live in Product Docs (Notion) under "Decisions & RFCs".
Ivy Laurent: awesome, this is super helpful. i'll fill the plugin key form and the research request. excited to join the critique on Wednesday 680
Kelsey Tran: welcome aboard! DM me if the plugin form needs any extra fields or you want a test key.
Sasha Bloom: welcome Ivy 44b we'll pair you with a mentor this week and drop the invite for the design critique. see you in the sync tomorrow.
Ivy Laurent: thanks everyone, appreciate the speedy help :)
